Accounting Officer Job at Atutechs C Limited




        
    

        
        Atutech is a software and technology services company primarily focused on delivering digital solutions and tech support for businesses. It is registered as a limited company.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accounting Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are looking for an Accountant to manage all financial transactions, from fixed payments and variable expenses to bank deposits and budgets.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage all accounting transactions
	Prepare budget forecasts
	Publish financial statements in time
	Handle monthly, quarterly and annual closings
	Reconcile accounts payable and receivable
	Ensure timely bank payments
	Compute taxes and prepare tax returns
	Manage balance sheets and profit/loss statements
	Report on the company’s financial health and liquidity
	Audit financial transactions and documents
	Reinforce financial data confidentiality and conduct database backups when necessary
	Comply with financial policies and regulations


Requirements


	Excellent knowledge of accounting regulations and procedures, including the Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)
	Hands-on experience with accounting software like FreshBooks and QuickBooks
	Advanced MS Excel skills including Vlookups and pivot tables
	Experience with general ledger functions
	Strong attention to detail and good analytical skills


Salary
N200,000 - N300,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Job Position: Public Relation Officer

	Helping people understand their health condition(s) and develop strategies to improve their health and well being.
	Helping to build understanding and social capital to support healthier behaviors and lifestyle choices.
	Delivering health information using culturally appropriate terms and concepts..
	Linking people to health care/social service resources.
	Providing informal counseling, support and follow-up as needed with patients.


Requirements


	Candidates should possess an HND, NCE, OND, BSc, HND , M.Pharm, MSc, OND in relevant discipline with relevant working experience as a community health worker or similar role.
	Experience working with people of different cultures and socio-economic backgrounds.
	Understanding of the healthcare system and how to help patients find necessary resources.


Salary
N200,000 - N400,000 per month.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Human Resources Executive",
  "description": "Kontz Engineering Limited operates as an innovative player in the automated security spectrum having a formidable alliance with world&rsquo;s leading security products manufacturers. Our products and services have been installed in more than 300 locations within and outside the shores of Nigeria, with businesses including banking, oil and gas, aviation, telecommunications, military, constructions and health.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Human Resources Executive

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full time&nbsp;

Role Description


	The Human Resources Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Lagos State, Nigeria.
	The individual in this role will manage day-to-day HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management support, and employee lifecycle administration.
	Responsibilities include maintaining and updating HR policies, ensuring compliance with local labor regulations, and coordinating payroll and benefits information with relevant stakeholders.
	The Human Resources Executive will handle employee relations matters, support learning and development initiatives, and provide guidance to managers and team members on HR best practices.
	The role also involves maintaining accurate HR records, preparing HR reports, and contributing to a positive, inclusive work environment aligned with Kontz Engineering Limited&rsquo;s values.

Human Resources Executive Job at Kontz Engineering Limited




        
    

        
        Kontz Engineering Limited operates as an innovative player in the automated security spectrum having a formidable alliance with world’s leading security products manufacturers. Our products and services have been installed in more than 300 locations within and outside the shores of Nigeria, with businesses including banking, oil and gas, aviation, telecommunications, military, constructions and health.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resources Executive

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full time 

Role Description
     

            
    




	The Human Resources Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Lagos State, Nigeria.
	The individual in this role will manage day-to-day HR operations, including recruitment, onboarding, performance management support, and employee lifecycle administration.
	Responsibilities include maintaining and updating HR policies, ensuring compliance with local labor regulations, and coordinating payroll and benefits information with relevant stakeholders.
	The Human Resources Executive will handle employee relations matters, support learning and development initiatives, and provide guidance to managers and team members on HR best practices.
	The role also involves maintaining accurate HR records, preparing HR reports, and contributing to a positive, inclusive work environment aligned with Kontz Engineering Limited’s values.


Qualifications


	Candidates should possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or a related field; professional HR certifications are an advantage.
	Candidates should possess strong skills in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management to oversee core people processes and support organizational objectives.
	Candidates should possess solid experience in HR Operations and HR Policies to ensure efficient administration and compliance with employment regulations.
	Candidates should possess proven capabilities in Employee Relations to address workplace issues, foster engagement, and promote a respectful, inclusive culture.
	Candidates should possess excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
	Candidates should possess proficiency in HR information systems, Microsoft Office tools, and a good understanding of Nigerian labor laws and HR best practices.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs and a cover letter detailing their relevant experience to: [email protected]  using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Customer Support Officer Job at TeamAce Limited




        
    

        
        
     

            
    

TeamAce Limited - Our client, a reputable organization in the Fintech sector, is recruiting to fill the position below:


Job Position: Customer Support Officer

Job Location: Fully remote.
Employment Type: Full-time



Job Summary


	As the Customer Support Officer, you will manage customer interactions, resolve issues efficiently, and ensure a seamless user experience across all customer touchpoints while supporting overall service delivery.


Responsibilities


	Respond to customer inquiries across multiple channels (email, chat, and other platforms)
	Resolve customer complaints promptly, including issues relating to stablecoin and cryptocurrency transactions, and escalate complex cases when necessary
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and transactions
	Collaborate with internal teams (Tech, Compliance, Operations) to resolve customer issues
	Monitor recurring issues and provide feedback to improve service processes


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Communications, or a related field
	Minimum of 1–3 years of experience in customer support, preferably within a fintech, cryptocurrency, blockchain, or other fast-paced digital financial services environment
	Working knowledge of stablecoins, cryptocurrency transactions, blockchain fundamentals, and digital wallets is mandatory
	Proficiency in customer support tools, CRM platforms, and Microsoft Office applications with strong communication and interpersonal skills.




Salary
N300,000 – N450,000 Monthly.
